newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO BOOK UEFA PLACE WITH WIN AT TENERIFE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO BOOK UEFA PLACE WITH WIN AT TENERIFE.

text.p: Spanish champions Atletico Madrid guaranteed a place in next season's UEFA Cup by beating Tenerife 3-2 on Thursday in a game postponed from January because of illness in the Atletico squad.

For Tenerife, semi-finalists in this year's competition, the result was a major set-back in their bid to lift themselves from ninth position into one of the top seven places that give access to Europe.
Atletico went ahead through Milinko Pantic in the 13th minute, but Slavisa Jokanovic hit straight back and Tenerife went ahead with a Meho Kodro header on the half hour.
Juan Eduardo Esnaider headed the equaliser just after the break, and Atletico won the game with a Diego Simeone goal 16 minutes from time.
